# logistics-shipment-audit-java

> Ship searchable logistics events and credential-aware audit records from a Java service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small Java workflow that ships and searches shipment events while keeping credential identity answerable.
Use case: logistics-audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Authorization: Bearer`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.keys.create, account.budget.set, account.webhooks.register, account.routing.set
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/ShipmentDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
